limitations: Relative references inside macros and parameterized paths are recorded separately because they depend on expansion context.
Only typed SDL file references are checked; this does not emulate all resource registration or runtime requests.
Ammo selection is statically checked by explicit tags; runtime resupply has not been executed.
Native XML schema was validated with the .NET UPA compilation check disabled because vanilla schema content models are ambiguous under that compiler rule.
Creation of a skirmish, visuals, sound, binary-model internals and actual battle behavior remain untested without launching the game.
